run_handle_unary_unary: run the async unary-unary RPC handler that extracts peer identities and auth context from servicer context
test_insecure_auth_context: test the insecure channel auth context to verify peer identities and auth context are empty
test_secure_no_client_cert: test the secure channel without client certificate to verify transport security type and session reuse
test_secure_client_cert_auth: test the secure channel with client certificate to verify x509 common name and peer identities
test_tls_session_resumption: test TLS session resumption using an LRU session cache to verify ssl_session_reused changes from false to true
